svg.title: Accuracy at comparable modeled compute
svg.desc: Accuracy is 68.7% for self-consistency, 70.0% for debate, and 71.4% for mixture of agents. Approximate individual 95% intervals overlap. Mixture of agents gains 2.7 percentage points over self-consistency. Llama 3.1 70B; 1,000 MMLU-Pro questions. Best reported configurations within the tested compute range. Whiskers are approximate 95% binomial intervals, calculated using the paper's formula. These are not intervals on the differences.
svg.metadata: https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-srw.1.pdf | Section 4.1 and Section 8; ACL SRW, July 2026
